name: flythrough
description: A scroll-driven video player with named stops: the page scroll scrubs through a video's frames, and each stop shows its own card.
author: xjenosa

scripts.demo:frames: node bin/flythrough.mjs frames demo/footage/grey-flight.mp4 --out demo/public/tour --set landscape=1920@70 --set portrait=608x1080@70 --stops demo/footage/flight.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/react/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p examples/vue/tsconfig.json && svelte-check --workspace examples/svelte --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --output human
scripts.test:browsers: node test/host-test.mjs && node test/review-test.mjs && node test/toolbar-test.mjs && node test/input-test.mjs && node test/features-test.mjs && node test/examples-test.mjs && node test/examples-test.mjs --packed && node test/host-test.mjs --no-gsap && node test/review-test.mjs --no-gsap && node test/input-test.mjs --no-gsap && node test/host-test.mjs --browser firefox && node test/review-test.mjs --browser firefox && node test/features-test.mjs --browser firefox && node test/examples-test.mjs --browser firefox && node test/host-test.mjs --no-gsap --browser firefox && node test/review-test.mjs --no-gsap --browser firefox && node test/host-test.mjs --browser webkit && node test/review-test.mjs --browser webkit && node test/features-test.mjs --browser webkit && node test/examples-test.mjs --browser webkit && node test/host-test.mjs --no-gsap --browser webkit && node test/review-test.mjs --no-gsap --browser webkit
